sourcePlan.title: KERN bends & thresholds

L0.name: Courtyard & operations
L0.note: A bent entrance leads through the occupied Map / Briefing room, then emerges into an offset passage and small core junction. An L-shaped court passage leads through a lounge into a different L-shaped west return. Corridor elbows are continuous open joins, with no doors. Room, security, stair and decon thresholds retain doors.

L1.name: Quarters & overlook
L1.note: Living rooms alternate with an open-ended stair lobby and overlook. Sleeping rooms are private branches off a continuous L-shaped quiet hall. The partial upper level remains inside the square outer envelope; the garden and Control void stay open.

B1.name: Expedition & research clusters
B1.note: Separate west vehicle ramp. Dirty gear → showers → clean stair is the only garage-to-base threshold. Research loops through prep and scanner rooms, with containment as secure dead ends.

B2.name: Stabilization & cave routes
B2.note: Six distributed nodes surround the exciter. A continuous maintenance ring connects every node. Rough cave passages bypass the west and north ring; a sealed chamber branches off the east route.

designReferences: Säynätsalo: protected outdoor court and differentiated thresholds
Rostlaube: clustered choices and short loops
Carpenter Center: multiple approaches and interlocking volumes
Yale A&A: sectional hierarchy and overlook
designSequence: East entrance → open L arrival → occupied Map / Briefing → offset north passage → small core cross
Core cross → open L court passage → Court room → open L west return → Records reading → Archive → short north gallery
Optional north loop: North gallery → Radar → Control → core east leg

envelope.note: Square above-ground perimeter. Interior garden remains completely open to sky.
